says: A Team adopted an environment's first edition; Alice composed a preparation from that adoption, activated her host session with it, and an observation shows the rules and knowledge units that arrived. The Team then authors a checklist source, publishes a newer edition that adds its pin, and adopts it; the adoption commits and returns only the adoption record. Observing Alice's session again still names her existing preparation and the same two units: the adoption changed neither her preparation nor what her session received. A preparation composed from the newer adoption names that adoption and adds the checklist unit, but nothing has activated a session with it, so observing it returns no delivery observation at all. The adoption record must never be returned or read as a delivery to any recipient.
